headline: Bitcoin slipped about 1% into the weekend after US stocks fell and oil jumped; next week brings the Fed decision, US growth and inflation data, and Coinbase earnings.

market.asOf: BTC read about 04:30 UTC Sat 24 Oct (11:30 Bangkok) from CoinGecko's bitcoin page. ETH, SOL and the Fear & Greed index could not be read this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips about 1% as US stocks fall and oil jumps
stories.summary: Bitcoin drifted a little lower into the weekend after US stocks fell on Friday and oil rose sharply. Expensive oil and higher bond yields make risky assets less attractive, so next week's Fed meeting is the next big test.
points: Bitcoin was $80,806 on CoinGecko at about 04:30 UTC Saturday (11:30 Bangkok), down 1.3% over 24 hours.
At Friday's close the Dow fell 1.23% to 52,215.16, the S&P 500 0.52% to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq 0.21% to 25,955.34, per Yahoo Finance.
Brent crude rose 3.14% to settle at $116.72, per Sharecast, which tied the move to reports that the US and Israel were drawing up plans for renewed attacks on Iran.
Sources differ on the 10-year Treasury yield: Sharecast says 4.999%, Yahoo Finance says 4.988%.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell for a second straight week, while the Dow ended the week higher, per Yahoo Finance.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: Stock market today, 23 Oct

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs post their biggest one-day outflow since June; Friday's figures are still pending
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw $635.6 million leave on Thursday 22 Oct, more than wiping out Wednesday's inflow. Friday's flow figures had not been published when this edition was written.
points: Net outflow of $635.6M on Thursday, the largest daily outflow since June, per The Block.
By fund on Thursday: BlackRock's IBIT -$254.1M, Fidelity's FBTC -$217.5M, ARK's ARKB -$109.4M; Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $2.3M, per The Block.
The week through Thursday is still about +$442.7M net, per The Block.
October to date is now about -$174.5M after Thursday, per TFTC's flow table.
Spot ether ETFs lost $110.6M on Thursday, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows
Cointelegraph: Bitcoin ETFs erase October gains

stories.title: Senator asks Tether for records on payments to a firm co-founded by ex-White House crypto adviser Bo Hines
stories.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wrote to Tether and to Nxum, the consulting firm linked to Bo Hines, asking for records of their dealings. The figures in his letter come from Wall Street Journal reporting and are allegations, not findings.
points: Tether agreed in May 2025 to pay Nxum $415,000 a month, according to the senator's release citing the Wall Street Journal.
More than $6M reportedly flowed to Nxum, per the release.
Records are due by 6 Nov 2026, per the release.

sources.label: Decrypt: Senate Democrat probes Tether payments
Cointelegraph: Senator probes Bo Hines-Tether deal

briefs.title: More companies object to tokenized versions of their stock on OKX and ICE's platform
briefs.summary: Objections have reached 22 of the 62 proposed companies, with Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit among the latest, per Reuters via Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: IRS reportedly plans lower penalties for voluntary disclosures, crypto included
briefs.summary: Forbes reports a revamped program launching before December with a 120-day target to resolve cases; there is no formal IRS release yet, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: SEC adds tokenized securities to its 2027 exam priorities
briefs.summary: Tokenization is flagged as a focus area, while crypto again has no standalone exam category, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Initia halts its network after an exploit
briefs.summary: An attacker reportedly minted unbacked tokens; one researcher first put the loss at more than $2.6M and D2 Finance valued the attacker's wallet at about $2.73M. Initia has not confirmed the loss, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: HSBC launches a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for PayMe users
briefs.summary: RedCoin (RCHKD) is offered to more than 3.3 million users of HSBC's PayMe app, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Bitcoin Core will patch easy-to-find bugs right away
briefs.summary: Bugs that are easy to discover, for example with AI tools, will be fixed immediately instead of waiting out the usual disclosure delay, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: China targets a national blockchain network by 2030
briefs.summary: A plan published Friday by the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission aims to largely complete the network by 2030, per Cointelegraph.
